registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-C-E candidate-only substrate binding and rollback preflight
registered_addition_groups.rationale: All five occurrences are bounded deterministic SHA-256 encoding, local binding-list accumulation, and append calls against newly constructed InMemoryEventKernel instances used only to prove replay, rollback-prefix reconstruction, and checkpoint-resume equivalence. The module imports no SQLite/file/network/process/thread/clock surface, performs no authoritative append or persistence write, installs no live writer, changes no production default, transfers no legacy goal authority, and does not open M3-E.

All twelve occurrences are test-local deterministic label hashing, lifecycle-transition accumulation, intentional frozen-object and tampered-payload/context probes, and temporary AST import/call collection sets. They add no production mutation, persistence writer, capability edge, runtime integration, legacy-domain transfer, or M3-E authority.
